title: Ambient world life
description: Take a game whose world feels deserted to small reusable ambient systems: review footage and lyrics, write a backlog, build modules on the vendored GameCore world-life kit, add a song beat map and character attention, test, measure the frame cost and showcase every asset. Derived from the ShammyVerse world-life work.

optional_ai: Drafting the backlog from footage notes and lyrics; a person sets priorities and approves every item.
Writing module code on the kit; a person reviews the look and the tests.

godot.title: Godot 4 console executable (Movie Maker)
godot.notes: Movie Maker records at the window size; the tool applies the resolution through a temporary override.cfg.

project_folder.title: Godot project folder
project_folder.help: The game's folder that contains project.godot. The kit is vendored into addons/gamecore_world_life/.

godot_executable.title: Godot console executable
godot_executable.help: Exact engine build used for capture (Godot_*_console.exe on Windows); recorded in the production record.

review_sources.title: Footage and text to review
review_sources.help: Music videos, playthrough captures, lyrics or story text; one per line.

song_audio_folder.title: Runtime song files
song_audio_folder.help: Runtime songs for the beat map (tempo and first-beat offset per song).

beat_map_output.title: Beat map output
beat_map_output.help: A .gd path writes a GDScript constant (always exports); .json writes JSON.

spoiler_policy.title: Spoiler policy
spoiler_policy.help: spoiler-light: ambient life never shows rewards, finished objectives or story moments saved for later chapters.

perf_budget_ms.title: Frame-cost budget
perf_budget_ms.help: Extra frame time allowed for the ambient systems at the busiest spot (windowed, vsync off).

stages.title: Review footage and lyrics
stages.description: Count held shots with empty backgrounds and list lyric or story moments the game never shows.

checks.title: Backlog priorities and spoiler exclusions approved

stages.title: Vendor the world-life kit
stages.description: Copy 3d/godot/world_life/world_life_kit.gd and sea_breach.gd into the game with a SHA-256 lock per file.

stages.title: Build the modules
stages.description: Game code: a root node (clock, beat, quality, effects volume) and one module per family, each near-camera, nonblocking, with stage(kind) and set_quality().

checks.title: Modules reviewed against the spoiler policy

stages.title: Map song beats
stages.description: tools/song_beats.py estimates each song's tempo and first-beat offset for dances, drums and stomps.

checks.title: Every song has a tempo between 70 and 180 BPM

stages.title: Test and check regressions
stages.description: Headless test of every module and stage(); earlier tests rerun with the systems switched off to separate old failures from new.

checks.title: World-life test passes with no script errors
Every failing earlier test also fails with the systems off

stages.title: Measure the frame cost
stages.description: Windowed, vsync off: frame time with and without the systems at the busiest spot, recorded with the hardware.

checks.title: Extra frame time within the budget

stages.title: Showcase every asset
stages.description: One titled shot per asset through the game-asset-showcase workflow: screenshots while building, a demo video at the end.

steps.title: Review and plan
steps.summary: Footage and lyrics in, an approved backlog out.

steps.title: Vendor and build
steps.summary: Install the kit, build the game's modules and map the song beats.

steps.title: Test, measure and show
steps.summary: Headless tests, regression check, frame cost and the showcase.
